q: LaSalle's Invariance Principle extends Lyapunov stability to asymptotic stability when dV/dt ≤ 0. It concludes that trajectories converge to:
opts: The largest invariant set contained in {x : dV/dt = 0}
exp: LaSalle: when V̇ ≤ 0 (not strictly negative), solutions converge to the largest T-invariant set in E = {V̇ = 0}. This handles cases like V̇ = 0 on a set rather than just at the equilibrium.
